title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #3

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these things was created by God, according to the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. The sun, moon and stars
   B. Only plants
   C. Only the sea
   D. Only humans

2. Which verse says that God's word is a lamp for our feet? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 15:8
   B. Acts 11:26
   C. Genesis 12:1
   D. Psalm 119:105

3. Which action shows respect for a grandmother? (1 mark)
   A. Helping her to carry water
   B. Shouting at her
   C. Laughing at her
   D. Ignoring her greeting

4. If the first adult you tell does not help you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell nobody
   B. Give up
   C. Forget it
   D. Tell another trusted adult

5. How many books are in the whole Bible? (1 mark)
   A. 39
   B. 27
   C. 100
   D. 66

6. Which group of books in the Old Testament is known as the Law? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis to Deuteronomy
   B. Isaiah to Malachi
   C. Joshua to Esther
   D. Job to Song of Songs

7. What was Zacchaeus' job? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd
   B. Priest
   C. Chief tax collector
   D. Fisherman

8. What does it mean to repent? (1 mark)
   A. To run away
   B. To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   C. To blame others
   D. To pretend nothing happened

9. Who asked Balaam to curse the Israelites? (1 mark)
   A. King Balak
   B. Herod
   C. Joshua
   D. Pharaoh

10. Whom did Joseph credit for the interpretation? (1 mark)
   A. The cupbearer
   B. God
   C. Himself
   D. The magicians

11. What name did the angel tell Mary to give her son? (1 mark)
   A. Emmanuel only
   B. John
   C. Jesus
   D. Gabriel

12. What does the word "annunciation" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A journey
   B. A song
   C. A festival
   D. An announcement

13. What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him? (1 mark)
   A. Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   B. Ran away
   C. Stayed sitting
   D. Hid

14. What was Bartimaeus' problem? (1 mark)
   A. He was a leper
   B. He was lame
   C. He was blind
   D. He was deaf

15. What did Jesus say to the woman? (1 mark)
   A. Follow me
   B. Give me water
   C. Don't cry
   D. Go home

16. What does it mean to forgive? (1 mark)
   A. To hide
   B. To hit back
   C. To forget your name
   D. To stop being angry and not pay the person back

17. Which of these is a physical need? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. Food
   C. A loud radio
   D. A toy

18. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A prayer
   C. A kind of coin
   D. A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson

19. What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51? (1 mark)
   A. Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   B. Let us punish Him
   C. He is a liar
   D. He is a king

20. Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham
   B. Daniel
   C. Joseph
   D. Samson

21. Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Ephesians 4:25
   D. Luke 19:5

22. What does responsibility mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   B. Being lazy
   C. Breaking things
   D. Leaving jobs to others

23. Which helps you to avoid situations that lead to sin? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring parents
   B. Choosing good friends
   C. Going to wrong places
   D. Keeping bad secrets

24. Which of these is a result of sin? (1 mark)
   A. It brings health
   B. It brings praise
   C. It brings peace
   D. It separates us from God

25. Which disciple betrayed Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. Judas Iscariot
   C. Peter
   D. Andrew

26. According to Matthew 10:3, which disciple is listed together with Thaddaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Judas Iscariot
   C. James son of Alphaeus
   D. Andrew

27. What does "hallowed" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rich
   B. Old
   C. Loud
   D. Holy

28. Which fruit is shown by walking away instead of hitting back? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Envy
   C. Self-control
   D. Greed

29. What does defile mean? (1 mark)
   A. To make unclean or harm
   B. To help
   C. To clean
   D. To praise

30. Who should give permission before you use an app? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. Your parent or guardian
   C. A friend
   D. A stranger

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State three qualities of Mary that a child can copy. (3 marks)

32. Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member. (4 marks)

33. Explain how a child can show compassion at school and at home, and why prayer is important when facing challenges. (5 marks)

34. Describe what a child should do after sinning, in four steps. (4 marks)

35. Explain the two greatest commandments and how a child can obey them. (5 marks)

36. Describe four ways of growing the fruit of the Spirit. (4 marks)

37. Write the message of Luke 1:37 in your own words and describe a situation in which it can comfort a child. (4 marks)

38. Why was the widow of Nain in great need? (2 marks)

39. Explain how Stephen's forgiving spirit is like that of Jesus and how a child can copy it. (5 marks)

40. Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning. (5 marks)

41. State three results of telling lies. (3 marks)

42. Give two lessons from the story of Balaam and his donkey. (2 marks)

43. Name two of the twelve disciples who were brothers. (2 marks)

44. What does the name Nazirite refer to in the story of Samson? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — The sun, moon and stars
   Genesis 1 says that God made the sun, moon and stars, and also the land, sea, plants and animals.

2. D — Psalm 119:105
   Psalm 119:105 compares God's word to a lamp and a light.

3. A — Helping her to carry water
   Helping shows respect and care.

4. D — Tell another trusted adult
   Keep telling until someone helps.

5. D — 66
   39 + 27 = 66.

6. A — Genesis to Deuteronomy
   The first five books are called the Law.

7. C — Chief tax collector
   Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector.

8. B — To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repentance includes turning away from wrong.

9. A — King Balak
   Numbers 22 says that Balak, king of Moab, sent for Balaam.

10. B — God
   Joseph said, "God will give Pharaoh the answer."

11. C — Jesus
   Luke 1:31 says to call Him Jesus.

12. D — An announcement
   The annunciation is the announcement of Jesus' birth to Mary.

13. A — Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   He threw off his cloak and came to Jesus.

14. C — He was blind
   Bartimaeus was a blind beggar.

15. C — Don't cry
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

16. D — To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   Forgiving lets go of revenge.

17. B — Food
   Food, water, clothing and shelter are physical needs.

18. D — A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   Jesus used parables to teach.

19. A — Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

20. C — Joseph
   Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

21. C — Ephesians 4:25
   Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

22. A — Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   Responsibility means doing what is expected.

23. B — Choosing good friends
   Good friends help us do right.

24. D — It separates us from God
   Sin harms us and others.

25. B — Judas Iscariot
   Judas betrayed Jesus.

26. C — James son of Alphaeus
   Matthew 10:3 pairs James son of Alphaeus with Thaddaeus.

27. D — Holy
   Hallowed be your name means may your name be honoured as holy.

28. C — Self-control
   Self-control is controlling actions.

29. A — To make unclean or harm
   Defile means to harm or make unclean.

30. B — Your parent or guardian
   Ask an adult first.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trust in God, obedience, humility, purity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: At school: share, comfort a sad classmate, include a lonely child. At home: help with chores, care for a sick family member. Prayer is important because God hears us and helps, and it gives peace and courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for God hearing, 1 for peace or courage, 1 for clear link to compassion.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Admit it, say sorry to God, say sorry to the person hurt, put things right, decide not to repeat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind, and love your neighbour as yourself. A child obeys by praying, reading the Bible, going to church, and by kindness, sharing and forgiving others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for loving God, 1 for loving neighbour, 1 for prayer or Bible, 1 for kindness, 1 for forgiving or sharing.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, practise one fruit at a time, ask for encouragement, say sorry and try again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Nothing is impossible with God. It can comfort a child who is afraid before an exam or when a family member is very sick, because God can help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable situation, 2 for explaining how it comforts.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: She had lost her husband and now her only son, so she had nobody to provide for her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the husband and 1 for the son.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them," on the cross. Stephen prayed that the sin would not be held against those who stoned him. A child can forgive those who mock or hurt them, pray for them and not take revenge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Stephen, 1 for the similarity, 1 for forgiving, 1 for praying or not taking revenge.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey God; do not be greedy; bless others; be kind to animals. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Peter and Andrew; James and John.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A person set apart for God from birth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set apart and 1 mark for for God.
